section_summary.extract_value: This section describes additional body image measures used in the study, specifically two subscales from the Multidimensional Body-Self Relations Questionnaire-Appearance Scales (MBSRQ-AS): Appearance Orientation (12 items) and Overweight Preoccupation (4 items). The section reports internal consistency coefficients (ordinal coefficient alpha = .90 for Appearance Orientation and .83 for Overweight Preoccupation) and references Cash (2000) for reliability information. This is a methods section describing measurement instruments, not reporting study results or participant demographics.
section_summary.evidence_source: Section 2.2.5 'Additional body image measures' - entire section describes the MBSRQ-AS instrument and its psychometric properties.
